title: Value of a lifted query
statement: Let $f$ map finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings, let $x,b$ be finite Boolean strings, and let $p,j$ be natural numbers. On the encoding formed by pairing $x$ with $b$, then pairing the result with the binary representation of $p$, and then pairing that result with the binary representation of $j$, the Boolean indicator of the lifted query language equals the following: in length mode, it is true exactly when $j<|f(x)|$; otherwise, it is the $j$th bit of $f(x)$, with false used when that position is beyond the end of the string.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings
The query mode is a Boolean value
